scope: Sequential in-process synthetic API calls; one real database queue reservation, no concurrent load or network latency. First use is not an OS cold-cache measurement.

environment.ocr: Tesseract 5.3.4, Poppler 24.02.0, local wrappers, por+eng, OMP_THREAD_LIMIT=1
environment.measurement_instrumentation: enabled; captured to memory by the test, no log file I/O
environment.temporary_storage: Unique private testing disk per run, on the same /mnt/c filesystem
